program_identity.name: historical host connectivity / biotic memory
program_identity.scientific_question: Do present-day post-IBD genetic discontinuities in narrow-host Lepidoptera retain the spatial imprint of Last Glacial Maximum fragmentation of their larval host plants, beyond the present-day host landscape?
program_identity.directional_hypothesis: Greater LGM host-mediated resistance predicts greater present-day post-IBD genetic turnover after current host-mediated resistance is controlled.

why_this_is_not_a_rescue_of_prior_host_t.prior_test: Current larval host-resource footprint similarity between species did not explain cross-species T_st heterogeneity.
why_this_is_not_a_rescue_of_prior_host_t.new_unit: within-species genetic edges in a genetically fresh Lepidoptera panel
why_this_is_not_a_rescue_of_prior_host_t.new_exposure: historical host-mediated resistance along each insect edge, reconstructed from palaeoclimatic projections of the insect's own larval host species
why_this_is_not_a_rescue_of_prior_host_t.new_response: within-species post-IBD edge turnover rather than source-target transfer
why_this_is_not_a_rescue_of_prior_host_t.new_claim: biotic interaction history leaves a spatial genetic memory within dependent consumers

freshness.strict_exclusion_rule: Exclude the complete opened 211-species Phase-4 survivor set, the complete S1 339-species design, the complete S2 500-species design, and every species in the response-blind fresh-1000 design universe. This is stricter than excluding response-opened species only.

phase1_geometry.marker: mitochondrial COI/COX1 family under the existing TTF alias normalization
phase1_geometry.panel_rule: Scan in fresh-rank order and freeze the first 600 geometry-eligible species before host filtering.

interaction_source.dataset: HOSTS - a Database of the World's Lepidopteran Hostplants
interaction_source.accepted_records: species-level larval host binomials only; genus-only and family-only host records cannot enter the primary host set
interaction_source.deduplication: unique insect species x accepted host plant species

host_taxonomy.rule: retain only exact unambiguous species-rank WCVP resolution to one accepted plant_name_id
host_taxonomy.native_range: introduced=0, extinct=0, location_doubtful=0 at WGSRPD level 3

narrow_host_domain.definition: 1 to 5 distinct WCVP-accepted species-level larval host plants
narrow_host_domain.rationale: The historical resource surface must represent a biologically constraining interaction rather than a diffuse union across dozens of hosts.

host_occurrence_preflight.rule_before_genetics: A separate response-blind occurrence feasibility receipt must freeze the exact supported host set and host-data completeness rule before any palaeo relation or nucleotide identity is opened.

palaeo_host_model.current_reference_time_slice: 0 BP diagnostic aligned to the existing TTF palaeoclimate contracts
palaeo_host_model.host_niche_model: pooled standardized four-variable climate space; species-specific Gaussian KDE climatic envelope; project unchanged current niche envelope to present and 21-ka climate
palaeo_host_model.host_union: For insect i with supported hosts h, U_i(x,t) = 1 - product_h(1 - S_h(x,t)); no abundance weighting and no result-dependent host weights.
palaeo_host_model.edge_sampling: five equally spaced interior/geodesic segment points under the inherited TTF segment convention
palaeo_host_model.edge_resistance: R_host_i,e,t = mean_q[-log(epsilon + U_i(x_q,t))], with epsilon frozen before palaeo-relation calculation
palaeo_host_model.historical_interpretation: beta_host_LGM asks whether past host fragmentation explains current post-IBD genetic turnover beyond present host fragmentation.

genetic_response.opening: confirmatory nucleotide identity remains closed until host-domain, occurrence, predictor-information, character-mask and synthetic qualification gates all pass
genetic_response.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance over jointly canonical A/C/G/T alignment columns
genetic_response.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean over valid cross-locality sequence pairs on unchanged frozen graph edges

primary_inference.primary_statistic: equal-weight mean beta_host_LGM across confirmatory species
primary_inference.required_calibration: exact realized confirmatory geometry must pass frozen private-null Type-I and declared historical-host positive-control power before nucleotide identity opening

development_confirmatory_separation.split_time: after exact WCVP/host-occurrence admissibility and before any genetic identity
development_confirmatory_separation.split_rule: deterministic SHA256 split under namespace historical-host-connectivity-panel-v0.1
development_confirmatory_separation.development_genetic_identity: remains closed; development is for response-blind implementation diagnostics and synthetic qualification only
development_confirmatory_separation.confirmatory_genetic_identity: one-shot opening only after all frozen gates pass

predictor_information_gate.timing: before character-mask or nucleotide identity opening
predictor_information_gate.primary_question: Does LGM host resistance retain identifiable variation after current host resistance within species?

direct_palaeo_validation.role: secondary response-blind validation of host-genus palaeo occurrence where taxonomic and geographic coverage permits
direct_palaeo_validation.reason: Neotoma contains dated pollen and plant-macrofossil observations but taxonomic resolution and spatial coverage vary strongly among host plants.

interpretation.positive: Past fragmentation of larval host resources left a detectable spatial genetic memory in narrow-host Lepidoptera beyond the present-day host landscape.
interpretation.qualified_null: Under qualified information and power, LGM host-mediated resistance did not explain current post-IBD genetic turnover beyond present host resistance in the tested fresh Lepidoptera domain.
interpretation.claim_ceiling: A positive result supports historical biotic constraint, not proof of a particular realized host population, refugium, or direct fossil interaction at every locality.

prohibited: reuse the previously opened S2/S3 host-resource genetic response
choose host breadth after seeing genetic response
replace species-level hosts with genus/family-only records after seeing genetic response
choose a favourable palaeoclimate time slice after seeing genetic response
drop a host or insect because its empirical genetic effect is unfavourable
promote Neotoma validation coverage into a post-result subgroup rescue
mine the opened 326-species codistributed response to select this predictor
next_step: Rebuild the exact HOSTS x WCVP sidecar, freeze the 1-5 accepted-host fresh insect domain, and run host occurrence feasibility before any palaeo host-resistance relation or genetic response.
